steps.title: Deploy to staging
steps.detail: Smoke tests run against the new build.

steps.title: Canary at 5%
steps.detail: A small slice of traffic gets the release.
steps.more: Error rate and p95 latency are compared with the previous release for 30 minutes. A regression of more than 10% stops the rollout automatically.

reveal.label: Why not ship everywhere at once?
reveal.body: A staged rollout limits the blast radius. If something breaks, only a small share of users sees it and rollback takes seconds.
